description: Provider descriptors and Connector-wide protocol features for the single supported Runtime Control protocol.

features.description: Connector-wide protocol features. switchFence: runtime.validateConfig and runtime.start accept operationId and switchRevision, runtime.start reports configDigest and instanceId, and a fenced runtime.start always replaces the instance. modelProbe: runtime.probeModelConnection sends one minimal model request with the running instance's connection. Unknown entries must be ignored; absent means none. channelReconcileFence: extends persistent switch fencing to runtime.stop and managed-instance reconciliation; required for automatic channel catch-up.
